You will learn software development, gain an understanding of how the workplace operates in the Netherlands, and participate in sessions on topics such as presenting, assertiveness, and teamwork. The production engineering teams are currently operating in an environment undergoing a full-scale ERP migration to SAP, which introduces complex challenges around data mapping, data quality and legacy system integration.
